column1: # screening_decisions.tsv -- the project owner's own include/exclude verdicts, one per
# publication, recorded from how PDFs were sorted under
# These are NOT screening_record.triage_state. That column is Zone H, a deterministic
# function of query_families.yaml and discovery.py, and the schema says it must never be
# overwritten directly -- the next discovery run rebuilds it. A person who read a paper
# and rejected it is not a function of the query file, so the verdict lives here and in
# the screening_decision table, where re-running discovery cannot erase it.
# in_atlas records whether the DOI matched a publication row at the time of writing. 'no'
# means the owner screened a paper discovery never returned: kept deliberately, because a
# decision about a paper the atlas has not seen is still a decision, and dropping it here
# would silently re-open the paper if discovery later finds it.
# pdf/ (17 files, unsorted) is absent on purpose. Undecided is not a decision.
